summary.countingRule: One normalized original English wording counts once; multiple ids, scale reuse, translations, and derived situations do not increase original count.

sources.title: International Personality Item Pool official alphabetical list
sources.notes: Includes all archived IPIP origins; clinical-origin items are flagged and are not approved for the website.

sources.title: Ten-Item Personality Inventory, Gosling author-hosted original
sources.notes: Ten paired-adjective self-rating items, counted as ten questions rather than twenty adjectives; Big Five keys are retained without remapping to the project's six axes.

sources.title: Mini-Markers, Gerard Saucier author-hosted original
sources.notes: Forty adjective self-ratings; distinct original wordings, not forty additional independent constructs. Original Big Five signed scoring keys retained.

sources.title: Thomas Tedone item assignment table hosted by IPIP
sources.notes: An item's signed key is scale-specific; the archive does not pretend it is a validated key for this project's six original axes.

sources.title: SAPA Master Item List
sources.notes: Official page describes about 6000 mixed constructs but says the CSV has been temporarily offline since 19 January 2018. Includes clinical/health content and approximately 2500 IPIP overlaps, so its headline count cannot be added to IPIP.

sources.title: Open Extended Jungian Type Scales development item pool
sources.notes: Official Appendix B applies a non-commercial share-alike license to the items and page; not included in this public-domain/MIT/Apache collection.

sources.title: Analog to Multiple Broadband Inventories
sources.notes: 181 items from IPIP; the 2019 respondent dataset does not create additional original items.

sources.title: NeuroQuestAi IPIP-NEO Data
sources.notes: 120/300 item subsets plus participant response records and calculated scores; dataset row counts are not independent question counts.

sources.title: Hugging Face IPIP-120/300 scores
sources.license: MIT dataset card; underlying IPIP public domain
sources.notes: Response records, not a new pool of hundreds of thousands of questions. No participant records downloaded for this project.

sources.title: Basic Interest Markers current author permission
sources.license: current author page restricts to noncommercial use
sources.notes: The original paper title calls these public-domain, but the current author-hosted scale page expressly says copyright and noncommercial permission. No items imported pending clear reusable terms.

sources.title: RIASEC Markers current author permission
sources.license: current author page restricts to noncommercial use
sources.notes: Paper title says public-domain; current author page expressly restricts free permission to noncommercial use. No items imported.

sources.title: O*NET Career Exploration Tools license
sources.license: CC-BY-ND-4.0 or separate O*NET Tools Developer License
sources.notes: Do not conflate the tools license with the O*NET database license. The verbatim-copy license does not permit derived questionnaire items; the separate developer terms need a future deliberate integration.
